I had more energy, I was sleeping better, and I felt more confident in my own skin.

And that's when it hit me: restrictive eating wasn't just about food; it was about freedom. It was about breaking free from the cycle of guilt and shame that comes with overeating, and embracing a healthier, more balanced lifestyle.
